grant add{email} on nodes (u:Patient) where u.private <> true to Hospital_Clerk;
grant add{address} on nodes (u:Patient) where u.private <> true to Hospital_Clerk;
grant add{phone} on nodes (p:Patient) where p.private <> true to Hospital_Clerk;
grant create on nodes (e:Staff) where e.age > 60 AND e.age < 18 to HR_Manager;
grant create on nodes (e:Staff) where e.status = "active" AND e.status = "inactive" to HR_Manager;
deny create on nodes (e:Staff) where e.name = "private" to HR_Manager;
grant create on nodes (e:Staff) where e.salary > 5000 AND e.salary <= 5000 to HR_Manager;

grant traverse on nodes (t:BillingRecord) where t.amount > 2000 to Auditor;

grant traverse on nodes (u:Patient) where u.age >= 18 AND u.age <= 65 to Auditor;
grant traverse on nodes (u:Patient) where u.age >= 25 AND u.age <= 40 to Auditor;
grant traverse on nodes (o:Diagnosis) where o.status = "completed" AND o.amount > 100 to Auditor;
grant traverse on nodes (o:Diagnosis) where o.status = "completed" to Auditor;
grant traverse on nodes (o:Diagnosis) where o.status = "completed" AND o.amount > 500 to Auditor;
grant traverse on nodes (a:MedicalEquipment) where a.value > 1000 to Auditor;
grant traverse on nodes (a:MedicalEquipment) where a.value > 500 to Auditor;
grant traverse on nodes (a:MedicalEquipment) where a.value < 0 AND a.value > 100 to Auditor;

grant traverse on nodes (e:Staff) where e.age == 18 AND e.age <= 18 to Auditor;
